card.name: The before 'administration' of antibacterials
card.fires_on: The word 'the' right after 'after' in the C. difficile warning, where 'administration of antibacterial agents' comes next. Also fires on a comma in a list of adjectives in one non-drug passage.

modes.label: Before administration
modes.description: The word 'the' after 'more than 2 months after' in the CDAD diarrhea warning, just before 'administration'.
modes.example: CDAD has been reported to occur more than 2 months after<< the>> administration of antibacterial agents.

modes.label: Comma in a list
modes.description: A comma after a noun in a list of adjectives about the Catholic Church's influence.
modes.example: decisively affecting its destinies<<,>> religious, literary, scientific, social and

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting 'administration' and related words such as admin and administrative.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before 'administration' is expected, as in the antibiotic diarrhea warning.
